_notes: NO secrets here: api_key_env names an environment variable; the key itself lives only in the environment / host secret store.
Every provider ships DISABLED. A provider may only be used in production when enabled=true AND terms_reviewed_utc is set AND model_verified=true.

base_url values are the providers' documented OpenAI-compatible endpoints; model ids and free-tier limits change often and MUST be verified against the provider's current docs/terms before enabling (record the date in terms_reviewed_utc and docs/LLM_PROVIDERS.md).
max_calls_per_day / max_tokens_per_day are OUR conservative self-imposed caps (counted from llm_calls), not the provider's published limits.
Only content from verified_permitted sources may be sent to any provider (llm/router.py eligibility gate).
Rollout order (owner, contingent on verification + terms review + secure credential injection): 1 groq, 2 gemini, 3 openrouter.

A provider with a 'models' list expands to one route per usable model, in order (fallback within the provider); each model needs its own verified=true and enabled=true. Budgets are shared per provider; cooldowns are per provider/model route.

Models are tried in listed order. Thinking models: hidden reasoning tokens count against max_output_tokens (reasoning_effort=low, 4000 cap).
